chapter_title: Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Fiv
spiritual_reading:
From the Divine Human in its own order, an outwardly operative truth proceeded from the region of intention; an inmost affection of wisdom proceeded from the region of discernment; living wisdom itself proceeded from the region where truth is seen in light; the saving presence of the Divine united with its own love proceeded from the region of governing purpose; and the pure receptive form of enlightenment proceeded from the region of deliberate reflection.

Thus a sufficient complement of primary principles was brought forth and made present. These five orderly goings-forth issued from the fullness of the Divine powers in their distinct operations. Each proceeded from the prior, and each became active and visible when the state of reception was ready for it.

fills.notes: Agent of outwardly operative truth proceeding from the region of intention; the title must be the emissary-function (truth going forth), not a personal authority-name.
Maintains the discrete-degree mapping in the substrate: mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration as distinct interior regions from which the five goings-forth proceed in order.

In the oldest register this denotes the saving presence of the Divine united with love (not ecclesial confession). The series demands the specific named hypostasis paired with “the Beloved” and sourced in “counsel,” i.e., governing purpose.

The correspondential sense requires these five to issue from the fullness of the primal Divine powers; “limbs of the Father” expresses operative powers in ultimates (effects), consistent with the substrate’s impersonal cosmology.

assessment: All lacunae are tightly constrained by the fivefold procession schema: each hypostasis must proceed from a distinct interior faculty in ordered degrees. Only ¶2 #4 has mild looseness because later layers can color the name, but the function and pairing in the series constrain it to the established substrate title.
